Amazing movie. Loved every minute of it..very well written and executed. Cinematography and acting is top notch. Hats off to the the crew. Highly recommended.

This is neither a great movie nor a bad movie. It's just about average. I was surprise by either 10 Star or 1 Star reviews and that prompted me to watch it. I think both 10 Star & 1 Star reviews are biased. 10 Star reviews are probably by Pro-Arab/Palestine viewers and 1 Star reviews are probably by Jewish Pro-Israel viewers and I am none of them. This movie was made in 2009 and based on that photography and sound quality is about average. Acting is mediocre but not terrible. Movie suffers from bad story, the ending is very predictable. This movie is kind of similar to Sally Field movie "Not Without My Daughter" with some action sequences thrown in. All in all, one time watch movie.

Everything about the movie is fantastical according to Egyptian imagination. Nothing is truthful, just lots of Israelis slaughtered and police cars destroyed. Total farce. Difficult to believe that anyone would even think that anything like this was a remote possibility.
It's a good movie because it has good action Good story Even good message I don't know why most of foreign people are hating this movie
